jobs.description:
Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- MBO/ vocational working and thinking level
- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance
- Full-time employment
- Working in a 5-shift system
- Travel allowance
- Holiday pay

jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Development of trainings and manuals

To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent.

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

Client Details

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Description

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.

 

What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication
 

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient
